{{short description|Danish mathematician}}
'''Johannes Mollerup''' (3 December 1872 &ndash; 27 June 1937) was a Danish mathematician.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.litteraturpriser.dk/hbog/dblm.htm|title = Forfattere, litteraturpriser mv|date = August 2021}}</ref><ref>[http://denstoredanske.dk/It,_teknik_og_naturvidenskab/Matematik_og_statistik/Matematikkens_historie/Johannes_Mollerup Johannes Mollerup]. Gyldendal – Den Store Danske.</ref>

Mollerup studied at the [[University of Copenhagen]], and received his doctorate in 1903.

Together with [[Harald Bohr]], he developed the [[Bohr–Mollerup theorem]] which provides an easy [[Characterization (mathematics)|characterization]] of the [[gamma function]].
